title: Docker - 기본 이미지
code:
FROM node:18-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm install
COPY . .
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["npm", "start"]

title: Docker - 다중 단계 빌드
code:
FROM node:18 AS builder
WORKDIR /app
COPY . .
RUN npm install && npm run build

FROM node:18-alpine
COPY --from=builder /app/dist ./
CMD ["node", "index.js"]

title: Kubernetes - Deployment
code:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: education-app
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: education
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: education
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: app
        image: education:latest
        ports:
        - containerPort: 3000

title: Kubernetes - Service
code:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: education-service
spec:
  selector:
    app: education
  ports:
  - protocol: TCP
    port: 80
    targetPort: 3000
  type: LoadBalancer

title: GitHub Actions - 테스트
code:
name: Tests
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v3
      - run: npm install
      - run: npm test

title: GitHub Actions - 빌드 및 배포
code:
name: Deploy
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - run: npm install && npm run build
      - run: docker build -t education:latest .
      - run: docker push education:latest

title: GitHub Actions - Docker 빌드
code:
name: Build Docker Image
on: [push]
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v2
      - uses: docker/build-push-action@v4
        with:
          context: .
          file: ./Dockerfile
          push: true
          tags: myregistry/education:latest

title: CloudWatch 알람
code:
resource "aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm" "cpu" {
  alarm_name          = "education-cpu-high"
  comparison_operator = "GreaterThanThreshold"
  evaluation_periods  = 2
  metric_name         = "CPUUtilization"
  namespace           = "AWS/EC2"
  period              = 300
  statistic           = "Average"
  threshold           = 80
  alarm_actions       = [aws_sns_topic.alerts.arn]
}

title: Kubernetes HPA
code:
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: education-hpa
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: education-app
  minReplicas: 2
  maxReplicas: 10
  metrics:
  - type: Resource
    resource:
      name: cpu
      target:
        type: Utilization
        averageUtilization: 70

title: 백업 전략
code:
#!/bin/bash
# 일일 데이터베이스 백업
DATE=$(date +%Y%m%d)
mongodump --out=/backups/mongo_$DATE
tar -czf /backups/backup_$DATE.tar.gz /backups/mongo_$DATE

# S3에 업로드
aws s3 cp /backups/backup_$DATE.tar.gz s3://education-backups/

# 로컬 백업 정리 (30일 이전)
find /backups -type f -mtime +30 -delete
